name: Aimed Border Beam
note: A registered <angle> drives a conic-gradient border; at rest a CSS animation orbits it, and near the pointer a JS spring takes the computed value and aims the beam at the pointer's bearing, narrowing and brightening it toward the edge. The inner spill finds the edge with CSS sin()/cos(), and the orbit resumes from wherever the spring left off via a negative animation-delay.

name: Plucked-String Contents
note: Every rule under the contents is an ideal string integrated with the exact Courant-1 leapfrog scheme: the pointer drags it into a triangle, and when it slips past the band the kink splits, travels, reflects and decays. Rows sit on one subgridded track set, :has() dims the rest of the list, and arrow keys, focus and Enter pluck too.

name: Misregistered Print Poster
note: Three identical copies of the poster each print only their own ink through per-plate custom properties, and overprint with mix-blend-mode: multiply. Pointer velocity is fed through each plate's own rotation and gain into a spring, so a swipe fans the inks apart; every pulled print settles on a fresh sub-millimetre misregistration, read out live.

name: Halftone Moon, Pointer Sun
note: A halftone sphere whose dot radii are the square root of Lambert shading times a maria albedo map, precomputed per size so each frame is one dot product per dot and a single batched fill. The pointer is the sun: its distance from the disc sets the phase angle, and the readout derives illuminated fraction, phase name and lunar age from the same light vector.

name: Cursor Preview Index
note: A work index whose preview window trails the pointer with a lerp, leans into horizontal velocity and slides a vertical reel of covers, so moving down the list scrolls the art up; :has() recedes the other rows. Enter or click opens the project with a clip-path FLIP from the preview's rect, the body staggers in through @starting-style, and Escape folds it back into its row.

name: Flip-Tile Mosaic
note: Two scenes share one landscape and are painted once per size into offscreen canvases; the mosaic is a grid of damped springs, each tile drawn as a slice of whichever face its angle shows, foreshortened by |cos| along the axis the pointer was moving, lifted and shaded mid-turn. Clicks and Space send a distance-delayed wave, and the Dawn/Dusk radiogroup re-rests every tile from opposite corners.

name: Proximity Weight Specimen
note: A type specimen where every letter reads a single custom property and CSS derives font-weight, colour and lift from it with calc() and color-mix(); the script writes one Gaussian falloff value per letter, only when it changes. A Lissajous focus point keeps it breathing at rest, the native range sets the reach, Invert flips the axis, and arrow keys step a cursor through the letters.

name: Expanding Trail Panels
note: A route rail where hover (with an intent delay) previews and click or arrow keys pin; the open panel takes seven flex shares on a linear() spring while its contents stagger in by --i and the elevation profile wipes on with clip-path. Below 760px the same markup becomes a 0fr to 1fr accordion via @container, and every figure ties out: the profiles' cumulative ascent equals the stated ascent, times follow Naismith, and the header totals are the sums.
